name: Deirdre, My Blade
source:
Deirdre, My Blade is a dark fantasy kinetic visual novel which follows the journey of a troubled young man, Lucas, and his mysterious traveling companion, Deirdre. Their deceptively ordinary appearance conceals a deeper past. As the unlikely meeting that brought the pair together hurls them into a dangerous conflict, the two must carve their path out of an uncertain future.

[From [url=https://anon-kun-denwa.itch.io/dmb]itch.io[/url]]
